name: ADCC BIM-checkability
description: Conjunctive composition. Seven properties are judged on separate axes; three aggregates and a verdict are derived from them. Each property contributes one independent constraint.
notes: The verdict is DERIVED, never elicited, in every configuration that applies these rules.
Atomicity is recorded as n.a. under short-circuit elicitation whenever an earlier property fails, which is why the top-level conjunction is not identifiable from elicited data alone.
A separately elicited holistic verdict may be compared against the derived verdict; that comparison is the check, and it requires the two to come from calls that cannot see each other.
